family.note: Declared here, before the rungs exist, so admitting them cannot look retrospective. They are a separate family from the S5 DeLong tests because the estimand differs (Macro-F1, not per-class AUC) and because folding them into a 42-test family would penalise the S5 result for a later session's additions. Both directions are pre-registered two-sided: S4 measured A7-oof costing 0.011 val Macro-F1, so it may well be a loss.
